name: app-light-banking-app-held-in-hand-with-shadow
title: Light Banking App in a Hand with Long Shadow
whatItIs: A cover with a hand holding a phone showing a pale banking home with a large balance, income card and quick-action avatars, against a soft grey wall with a cast shadow, with a title and logo at the corners.
whatItMeans: Soft light and shadow make a quiet, premium mood, and the hand keeps it human.
techniques: Natural window shadow across the wall
Pale grey UI matching the scene
Lilac cuff as a small colour note

vocabulary.definition: A shadow thrown onto a wall or surface.
A row of shortcuts to common tasks.
An interface in the same pale tones as its surroundings.
